taskTitle: Twelve HTTP status codes, by the book

checks.detail: 3 subtasks, read from the schema reply
5 phases had the tools designed for them

finalText:
All twelve codes are covered by RFC 9110, "HTTP Semantics" (STD 97, June 2022), at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html. I did not open the page myself and relied on the three worker reports.

**Which RFC is current:** All three workers saw no "Obsoleted by" line on the RFC 9110 page and found no newer RFC in their searches. That is only a negative check. The rfc-editor info page returned 404, so I can't say it was positively confirmed.

**Heuristic cacheability:**
- Section 15.1 of RFC 9110 lists the heuristically cacheable codes as "200, 203, 204, 206, 300, 301, 308, 404, 405, 410, 414, and 501", and says all other status codes are not heuristically cacheable.
- Worker group-c saw this text through a `find` result, and group-b saw it only as a search snippet. Neither read the full surrounding sentence.
- The workers also found explicit "is heuristically cacheable" statements in the sections for 203, 206, 308, 405, 410, 414 and 501.
- The sections for 303, 307, 413, 421 and 422 have no such statement, and those codes are not in the 15.1 list, so I marked them false.

**Renamed reason phrases:** 413 is now "Content Too Large", 414 is "URI Too Long" and 422 is "Unprocessable Content". Group-b reports 413 was "Payload Too Large" in RFC 7231. Group-c reports 414 was "Request-URI Too Long" in RFC 7231 and 422 was "Unprocessable Entity" in RFC 4918, but did not open either older RFC.

**Quotes:** Some quoted sentences wrap across lines in the page text (group-b noted this for 308, 405 and 413), so a checker may need to normalize whitespace.

| Code | Reason | Section | Heuristically cacheable |
|---|---|---|---|
| 203 | Non-Authoritative Information | 15.3.4 | yes |
| 206 | Partial Content | 15.3.7 | yes |
| 303 | See Other | 15.4.4 | no |
| 307 | Temporary Redirect | 15.4.8 | no |
| 308 | Permanent Redirect | 15.4.9 | yes |
| 405 | Method Not Allowed | 15.5.6 | yes |
| 410 | Gone | 15.5.11 | yes |
| 413 | Content Too Large | 15.5.14 | no |
| 414 | URI Too Long | 15.5.15 | yes |
| 421 | Misdirected Request | 15.5.20 | no |
| 422 | Unprocessable Content | 15.5.21 | no |
| 501 | Not Implemented | 15.6.2 | yes |
